subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this umbrella issue stay open as the cross-surface tracker, or should maintainers close it as superseded by the narrower reply-context and final-fallback items?
rationale: The source proves the central behavior is still not implemented on main, but active related work already covers each half and the choice to close the umbrella is a maintainer routing/product decision rather than a code fact.

options.title: Keep umbrella until linked work resolves
options.body: Leave this issue open to track the combined Control UI, runtime reply metadata, and no-output UX until the active narrower items land or are rejected.

options.title: Close as split across canonical items
options.body: Close this issue after explicitly pointing reply metadata to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88032 and final fallback semantics to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

options.title: Narrow to Control UI only
options.body: Retitle or scope this issue to the Control UI-specific part and let runtime/channel fallback contracts stay in their dedicated items.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella until linked work resolves
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open to track the combined Control UI, runtime reply metadata, and no-output UX until the active narrower items land or are rejected.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans Control UI, gateway protocol, and agent runtime boundaries where recent current-main history points to steipete as the best routing owner in the available evidence.
